verdict.rationale: Grok Bot runs its own computer-use agent on a persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem and terminal. The Agent Computer preview shows its clicks, typing and navigation, and Auto Review checks computer actions before they run. On the user's own desktop, the docs only show that Bots can run commands with per-command approval, not see and operate GUI applications there. missing for 10: documented visual/GUI control of applications on the user's local computer (as opposed to the cloud computer), independent hands-on corroboration of app operation beyond browser use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work

citations.quote: Your Bots run on a persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal
The preview shows clicks, typing, navigation, and current status.
Execution on Local Computer controls whether Bots can run commands on the desktop in front of you; per-command approval is the default
With Auto Review on, Grok Bot evaluates tool calls and computer actions before they run.
